summary: Frontend-only testing for new 'Betalat' (paid) checkbox and 'Buss' badge in AdminDashboard /admin. Logged in as admin/bergslagenadmin. Paid checkbox toggle+persistence across reload works correctly (checked persists true, then uncheck persists false). Filter buttons (Alla/6 km/14 km/47 km) work. Finish-time inline pencil edit opens input in TID column (regression OK). BUS BADGE VERIFICATION FAILED - not because of frontend code (takesBus() logic 'startsWith("ja")' is correct) but because seed data does not match the review request: GET /api/admin/registrations shows bibs 11 and 13 have bus_transfer='Nej, jag vill inte åka buss.' instead of 'Ja, jag vill åka buss...'. So bus-badge-11 and bus-badge-13 are correctly NOT rendered, but this contradicts the reviewer expectation.

minor.issue: Seed data mismatch: bibs 11 & 13 have bus_transfer='Nej, jag vill inte åka buss.' although review claims they should be 'Ja...'. All 15 runners currently have paid=false (good starting state).

integration_issues.issue: bus-badge-11 and bus-badge-13 are not visible in DOM because backend returns bus_transfer starting with 'Nej' for those runners. Frontend takesBus() correctly requires startsWith('ja'). To verify feature end-to-end, main agent needs to update seed data so bibs 11 & 13 have bus_transfer='Ja, jag vill åka buss...'.

action_items: Update seed data (or admin action) so bibs 11 and 13 have bus_transfer='Ja, jag vill åka buss (399 kr, betalas vid anmälan)' (or any string starting with 'Ja') so that bus-badge-11 and bus-badge-13 render as designed. After that, re-run bus-badge visual test.
Optional: bib 1 currently shows a stale finish time (00:00:07) from a previous iteration; consider clearing it in the seed reset step.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminDashboard.jsx takesBus() logic is robust (case-insensitive, trims, startsWith('ja')). No changes needed.
Backend endpoint POST /api/admin/registrations/{bib}/paid is functional and persistent (verified via UI reload cycle).
serialize_reg returns 'paid' default False on GET as expected.

success_rate.frontend: 80% (4/5 verifiable; bus badge blocked by seed data)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Paid checkbox persistence + reload cycle already verified. Main open item is seed-data adjustment for bus_transfer on bibs 11 & 13 so the bus-badge feature can be verified visually. Frontend takesBus logic is correct - do NOT rewrite it; instead fix seed data.
rca of the issue: Missing bus badges on bibs 11 & 13: root cause is data, not code. API returns bus_transfer starting with 'Nej' for those bibs, and the frontend correctly only renders the badge when it starts with 'ja'. Reproduction: login /admin, inspect DOM for [data-testid='bus-badge-11'] -> absent. Fetch /api/admin/registrations and inspect bus_transfer field. Mitigation: update seed script or admin data so those bibs have bus_transfer='Ja, ...'.
